notes.title: Early Access Version 3!
notes.content:
[NEW]
NEW Feature: Mission Passives System
	• Mission Passives can add density, increase EXP, loot, and reputation, boost Player Stats, reduce Enemy Stats and more!
	• Use Reputation Points to randomly roll passives.
	• 15 Total Mission Passive Slots (5 unlocked by default, remaining 10 locked behind Achievements)
	• 3 loadout pages to allow for different strategies!
	• Mission Passives are shared across characters/ships in the same difficulty/mode (Easy mode and Standard mode are shared, while Hard mode is separated)
	

NEW Feature: Achievement System
	• Added Achievements to the game!
	• Added Steam Achievements for the game!
	• Easy mode and Standard mode Achievements are shared, while Hard mode Achievements are separated.


[MISSIONS]	
	• Removed the Explorer, Champion, Elite, and Conquest shop buttons from the Mission Menu's shop. 


[COMBAT]
	• Dash skill has been added and is enabled by default (No skill tree investment needed).
	- Dash skill can be used when pressing the Spacebar key.
	- Dash skill has a 2 second cooldown.
	
	• Basic Attack skill has been added and is enabled by default.
	NOTE: Basic Attack already existed and was auto used with Auto Basic Attack, but now it is a skill you can add to the Skill Bar if needed)
	- Basic Attack hotkey is the V key. (Was V key and Spacebar key, but Spacebar key now applies to Dash skill)
	- Basic Attack can now be selected from the Skill List when assigning skills to the Skill Bar. (Allows Basic Attack to be used by a number key rather than its Hotkey)
	
	• Misc
	- The Mission Modifier "Player Skill Cooldown" is now a negative modifier (Makes player skill cooldowns a longer wait time)
	- Rolling Flat Health and %Health on Armor Plating equipment item has been increased.
	- Power Core equipment item can now roll % Physical Damage, and % Elemental Damage (The elemental damage is disabled though since those skills are not added yet)
	

[SKILL REWORK]
	• Multi Shot damage reduced from 40% to 30%
	• Multi Shot projectile count reduced from 7 to 5.
	• Multi Shot tooltip updated to clarify it doesn't shotgun.
	• Multi Shot's Repeat node +3 second Cooldown (from +2 second Cooldown).
	• Multi Shot's Repeat node now has +25% Physical Damage per breakpoint.
	NOTE: Multi Shot was a bit too strong, slight nerf added, but also now has an option to invest into big damage for longer cooldown.
	
	
	• Power Shot damage increased from 150% to 200%.
	• Power Shot gains +12% Physical Damage per point (up from 10%).
	• Power Shot energy cost increased from 25 to 35.
	• Power Shot's Impact Nova node now +10% Area of Effect (up from 8%).
	• Power Shot's Knockback node removed.
	• NEW Power Shot node: "Efficiency". +10% faster Cooldown per point. -1 Energy Cost per point.
	NOTE: Power Shot overall buff with higher base energy cost.
	
	
	• Drill Shot damage reduced from 70% to 60%.
	• Drill Shot hit count reduced from 5 to 4.
	• Drill Shot cooldown reduced from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.
	NOTE: Drill Shot damage nerf, but more spammable.
	
	
	• Seeker Shot base damage now 30% (down from 40%).
	• Seeker Shot base Proc Chance now 30% (up from 10%).
	• Seeker Shot base Bounce count now 4 (up from 2).
	• Seeker Shot gains +1% Physical Damage per point (down from 2%).
	• Seeker Shot's Activation Chance node now grants +3% Proc Chance per point (up from 2%).
	NOTE: Seeker Shot damage nerf, but more spammable via proccing
	
	• Rail Gun base Ammo count now 14 (up from 6).
	

[MISC]
	• Some icon art has been updated.
	• Notification Messages for things like Looting items, Achievements.
	• Settings Menu has a button "Item Delete Key" which can be enabled to quick delete items.
	• Hotkeys enabled for quick menu navigation:
		[S] key for Skill menu
		[M] key for Mission menu
		[E] key for Equipment/Item menu
		[F] key for Ship Select menu

notes.title: Game Version 1 - PATCH 2
notes.content:
• Fixed a rare crash when selecting a mission with modifiers.
• Fixed a rare crash when crafting a mission with modifiers.

• Tutorial - Confirm button only visible on final page rather than all pages.
• Tutorial - Slight improvement to Itemization page.

• Skill Tree Menu - If a player hasnt invested into the Skill Tree, the invest button will flash.
• Skill Tree Menu - If a skill on the Skill Tree hasnt met the Skill Tree Level requirement, it is darkened.
• Skill Tree Menu - Investing into a Skill will auto assign it to an open slot on the Action Bar.

• Sentry Skill: Changed base physical damage from 25% to 40%.
• Sentry Skill: Changed base max health from 25% to 35%.
• Sentry Skill: Changed Shoot Interval to Attacks per Second.
• Sentry Skill: Changed Energy Cost from 60 to 40.
• Sentry Skill: Changed Cooldown from 8 seconds to 6 seconds.
• Sentry Skill - Additional Sentry Node: Now grants +1 Sentry at level 1.
